name: OpenCage Geocoding API
best_for: open-data geocoding with permanent storage-friendly public terms
commercial alternative to public Nominatim or self-hosted Nominatim

pricing.free_trial: 2500 requests/day; 1 request/second; testing only; no credit card required; files up to 100 rows

monthly_examples.enterprise: from zl 8200/month; custom limits, terms and SLAs

pricing.taxes: reviewed pricing page states all prices are inclusive of applicable VAT
pricing.overage: subscription limits are soft; repeated overages may require moving to a higher tier

authentication.notes: API key is passed as a query parameter; no HTTP auth header required according to official docs.

sandbox.free_trial: 2500 geocoding API requests/day for testing; no credit card required
sandbox.test_keys: official docs publish special API keys for status-code testing
sandbox.notes: No Atlas credentialed live test was performed.

rate_limits.hard_limits: free trial and one-time plan customers

data_rights.attribution: data licenses and OpenStreetMap ODbL obligations must be respected
